subject: Observability

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: Error correlation ID is a fresh random GUID unrelated to the trace ID and only embedded in message text
findings.recommendation: Derive the correlation ID from Activity.Current.TraceId (fall back to a GUID only when no activity exists) and log it as its own template property (e.g. {CorrelationId}) so the user-facing ID links directly to the trace and logs.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: OTLP exporter scheme and protocol are hard-coded, overriding OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* configuration
findings.recommendation: Take the full endpoint (including scheme) and protocol from configuration, or leave Endpoint unset when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is provided, so TLS and protocol can change per environment without a code change.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: Only health endpoint returns a constant 200 and never reflects the required database dependency
findings.recommendation: Register AddHealthChecks() with a timed, read-only SQL Server/PostgreSQL check tagged "ready", and map separate shallow liveness and readiness endpoints that return 503 when the active data source is unreachable.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: No SLOs or SLIs documented for the service
findings.recommendation: Document availability and p95 latency SLOs for the API with their SLIs (e.g. based on http.server.request.duration) and an observation window.

findings.subject: Observability
findings.title: service.version comes from a hand-maintained config constant, not the deployed build version
findings.recommendation: Set serviceVersion from the build/assembly version (FileUtilities.GetApplicationVersion() is already available) and add deployment.environment.name from builder.Environment.

strengths.subject: Observability
strengths.title: Serilog configured from appsettings with compact JSON file sink, request logging and bridging to OpenTelemetry logs

strengths.subject: Observability
strengths.title: OpenTelemetry SDK instruments ASP.NET Core, HttpClient, Npgsql and SqlClient for traces and metrics, exported via OTLP to a collector

strengths.subject: Observability
strengths.title: Global middleware logs unhandled exceptions once at Error with the exception object; host failures logged at Fatal

checkResults.subject: Observability

checkResults.subject: Observability

checkResults.subject: Observability
checkResults.reason: Single anonymous constant-200 health endpoint with no readiness check for the required database; probe wiring (WAFO-15) not judged since IaC is out of scope.

checkResults.subject: Observability
checkResults.reason: README documents no SLO targets or SLIs for the deployable API.

checkResults.subject: Observability
checkResults.reason: service.version is a manually maintained config constant (already drifting from README) and no environment resource attribute is set.

notes: Service type: web API with SQL Server/PostgreSQL dependency; instrumentation mode: code-based OpenTelemetry SDK. No ActivitySource or Meter is created in src, so AddSource("PilotApi.Web") and AddMeter(OpenApi.Title) currently register nothing. Sampler is a hard-coded AlwaysOnSampler (deliberate, low volume; not parent-based). /about with show-details on an anonymous route left to security skills. WAFO-15 (probe wiring) not judged: IaC not reviewed (advanced usage off).
